name: Kuroishi (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kuroishi city emblem in white: two stylised angular characters side by side.
history: Municipal flag of Kuroishi, a city in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1889.

features.role: Kuroishi city emblem — two stylised angular characters side by side
